user.title: AI Image Task - general settings
user.description: Choose the image provider and how often the images should be refreshed.

data.name: Name
data.write_metadata: Write a .json file with the generation metadata

data_description.provider: Pollinations works without an account. The OpenAI-compatible option targets any endpoint exposing /v1/images/generations.
data_description.base_url: Leave empty for the provider default (https://gen.pollinations.ai). Use https://image.pollinations.ai for the legacy endpoint.
data_description.api_key: Optional. Raises the rate limits and unlocks premium models.
data_description.update_interval: How often both images are regenerated.
data_description.output_dir: Absolute path inside Home Assistant. Anything under /config/www is reachable at /local/...
data_description.retention_mode: Overwrite: only the current file. Keep last N: archives the previous versions and keeps the newest N. Keep for N days: archives and deletes anything older.
data_description.keep_count: Only used by the 'Keep last N' policy.
data_description.keep_days: Only used by the 'Keep for N days' policy.
data_description.history_subdir: Subfolder of the output folder where old versions are archived. Leave empty to archive next to the current file.
data_description.stagger_seconds: Anonymous Pollinations usage is limited to about one request every 15 seconds.
data_description.negative_template: How the negative words are merged into the prompt. Placeholders: {prompt} and {negative}.
data_description.generate_on_start: Disable if you prefer to wait for the first scheduled run.

data_description.filename: The current image always keeps this name, so dashboards can use a stable URL.
data_description.negative_prompt: Comma separated words to avoid. They are appended to the prompt because Pollinations has no dedicated negative prompt parameter.
data_description.model: zimage and flux are free. gptimage-family models may need an API key.
data_description.seed: -1 means a new random seed on every run; a fixed value gives reproducible results.
data_description.quality: Only honoured by gptimage, gptimage-large and gpt-image-2.
data_description.reference_image: Optional. Used by editing/img2img models such as kontext, nanobanana and seedream.
data_description.width: Requested size. Backends refuse sides below 512px, so a larger image is generated and then resized down.
data_description.height: Requested size. Backends refuse sides below 512px, so a larger image is generated and then resized down.
data_description.exact_size: Crop/resize the picture so the saved file matches the width and height above exactly (needs Pillow).
data_description.fit: cover crops to fill, contain adds white bars, stretch distorts.
